# cau hinh chung
set.seed(2026)

# cau hinh rieng cho cau f
f_alpha <- 0.05
f_tab <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(
  x, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE, ...
)
f_p <- function(x) format.pval(x, digits = 4, eps = 1e-5)
f_dec <- function(p) ifelse(p < f_alpha, "Bác bỏ H0", "Chưa bác bỏ H0")

# tham so neu cac chunk cau f con su dung
if (!exists("params")) {
  params <- list(
    B = 1999,
    seed = 2026,
    run_freedman_lane = TRUE
  )
}

f_B <- as.integer(params$B)
